physics: steady diffusion on a curved (circular) domain
qoi: convergence order of the error on a fixed probe grid
domain: the DISK of radius 3/4 centred at (1/2, 1/2), i.e. all (x,y) with (x-1/2)**2 + (y-1/2)**2 < (3/4)**2. The boundary is a circle, not a polygon; the mesh must follow it.
bc_text: u = 0 on the whole circular boundary
element: first-order (linear) triangular elements with STRAIGHT edges, so that the polygon the mesh forms approximates the circle. Use first order: with straight-edged elements a higher order would be limited by the geometry error anyway.
mesh_text: unstructured triangular meshes of the disk with target element size h = 1/8, 1/16, 1/32, all three levels. Halve the target size from level to level.
notes_public: every probe point listed below lies strictly inside the disk.
